book.name: Faisok
book.title: A Maana Faisok Sina Mu Yaamut Na Luuk A Lisan A Fataraguiaana Lagasai Xe Si Tiofilas

content: Pe Aikoniam na Pol nare Baanabas re laak lana lifu ina faxuvulan sina mu Juda. E pave re ferawai lapaana gutan sina Piran e voxo maana rabuna xaves ti la palou ina mu Juda e mu rabuna aava ri pife Juda, ri namkai se Yesus.
Taasaxa mu Juda aava ri bai namkai, ri ferawai fasaat se Pol nare Baanabas e ri fatamasiak a lamonan sina mu rabuna aava ri pife Juda talo ri taa tisui a mu rabuna aava ri namkai.

Na Pol nare Baanabas re waan pave pana maana yaan xaves. E lana waanan sire, re ferawai faagut pana xakaavangan xatam sina Memai. A Memai a turoxoian a ferawaian sire e tavai nare pana gutan xena vil a maana buk faisok ina gutan e a maana mo faꞌipul.
A mu rabuna ti la bina ri lamon fepatok. Saxano rabuna ri usi a mu Juda e saxanofuna ri usi nare ro yaamut.
Saxano rabuna aava ri pife Juda e saxano Juda ri fexuus kasam e nari xuvul pana saxano paamua siri, ri lamon o ri taa bilai fasaat xe sire e ri taa soxoi nare pana faat.
Taasaxa nare, re texaas sena e re taꞌulan fatapusan a bina aave e re sinuf xe la ro bina pe Laikonia, ri xali nare pa Listra e Daabe.
Pave e lana nu bina faasilak, re taxa lo ferawai pana Lagasai Roxo.
Lavaxa, pe Listra a toxan a mataa kana maalapen. Nane a malaanabeꞌ ti lana modaxan sina e pi sasangas.
Nane langai layaan na Pol taxa ferawai e na Pol a xalum fatateaxe e texaas o a namkaian sina a fexaxaas sena vil faroxoiaana.
E na Pol a kuus falava, “Tigina fatak xuluna ro kaam!” E voxo a mataa aave a tigina e tangpat pana sangas.
Layaan a malila ri xalum a mo na Pol fo vile ri xukulai lana pok bina siri, a pok bina ti Laikonia, e ri kuus, “A mu piran ri fo sivimaan la palou itaara malaan sena matatuuna.”
Na Baanabas ri xalie pa Seus e na Pol ri xalie pa Irmiis senaso nane fuuna tigina paamua e ferawai.

A lifu lotu si Seus a tigina faasilak lamalei sena bina e a priis ina lotu aave a siak lisan a maana bulmakau e maana fur xe la yalaxau ina bina senaso nane xuvul pana mu rabuna ri vubuk tavai a ro yaamut pana tatavaian siri.
Taasaxa layaan na Pol nare Baanabas re langaie re ririk a marapi sire xa e re fala xe la palou ina malila e re xukulai,

“Mi rabuna, xenaso mi taxa vil malaane? Nemaame xo maame rabuna malaan semi mon. Maame taxa lisan a Lagasai Roxo xe simi e maame taxa xuus nami o mi taa taꞌulan a maana mo palau aanabeꞌ e mi taa usi a Piran aava vesan a vata e xavala e laman e a maana mo xapiak aava ri waan lana.
La yaan kavai a rabuna pe lana mu bina ri usi a vilaana siri saxa saxa e a Piran a kuus turoxo pana.
Taasaxa, nane pife fepalauan nami. Nane tavai nami pana raafui ti laaꞌui e a faboak a fanganan lana uma simi e vaxa a tavai nami pana maana buk fanganan xaves e a fabas a xunus imi pana faamamaasan.”
Naapalaan a ro yaamut re ferawai malaan a mu rabuna ri vubuk tatavai pana fanganan xe sire.
E mui saxano Juda ti Antiaak e Aikoniam ri savat e ri yuuf a malila pana ferawaian siri. Ri soxoi na Pol pana faat e ri raagan fasavate xe lamalei senaso ri lamon o nane fo maat.
Taasaxa mu rabuna aava ri namkai, ri tigina fakaliuane e nane tamasiak e ulaa fulaa xe la bina. E a yaan mui, nare Baanabas re falet xe pul Daabe.
Na Pol Nare Baanabas Re Ulaa Xe Pe Antiaak Pe Siria
Re ferawai pana Lagasai Roxo pe Daabe e maana rabuna ri puk a lamonan siri e ri namkai. E mui re ulaa fulaa xe pe Listra, Aikoniam e na Antiaak.

Re ferawai xe sina mu fetinan xena fagutaan nari talo ri taa waan fatateak lana namkaian tuuna siri. Re fepitaa malaan, “Taara taa falet tuuna xe lana lagafan xaves xena laak la fatataganan sina Piran.”
Na Pol nare Baanabas re siak fati a mu paamua lana mu lotu saxa saxa. E lamina fenungan e falfaalan re timin nari lapaana xakaavangan xatam sina Piran senaso ri fo lisan tuunei nari xa xe sina.
Lamina faletan sire pe Pisidia re falet xe Pemfilia.
Layaan re fo fepitaa pana Lagasai Roxo pe la bina Perga re sivi xe Atalia.
Pave re xawas xuluna xaati e re ulaa xe Antiaak a fufubina ina faisok sire.

Layaan re savat pe Antiaak re xel faxuvul a mu rabuna aava ri namkai. E re xuus fatexaas nari pana maana mo xaves aava Piran fo vile sere e malaafaa nane faigotan a salan talo a mu rabuna aava ri pife Juda, ri taa puk a lamonan siri xena namkai.
E re taagul pave pana maana yaan xaves xuvul pana mu rabuna aava ri namkai.
